artworks.title: 81. Flowing Well
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a stereoscopic view of an oil derrick in a sparse landscape. The point of view is from ground level, looking up at the tall wooden structure. The horizon line is low, with the derrick towering against the sky. In the distance, there are scattered small buildings, additional derricks, and some remaining trees. The overall color palette is a muted sepia tone. Closest to us, the base of the derrick shows wooden structures and two figures. The surrounding area has a hilly terrain with wood debris, showing a human impact on the environment.

artworks.title: Mather's Historical Oil Region Views of Western Pennsylvania
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a book cover. The cover shows the title "Mather's Historical Oil Region Views of Western Pennsylvania." The cover is dark with gold lettering for the title and decorative filigree below it. At the bottom, it reads "Titusville, Penn'a. 1895."

artworks.title: The Old Barn, Arreton, Isle of Wight
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache on paper mounted on a stretcher
artworks.creditLine: The Helena E.M. Gunnarsson Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a large building complex with a thatched roof at the center. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, offering a clear view of the surroundings. A line of trees marks the high horizon, with sloping hills visible beyond the buildings. The painting features soft, detailed brushstrokes, especially in the foliage and textured roofs. The color palette consists of earthy tones like warm browns, greens, and muted grays. A pond in the foreground reflects the structures and trees, with a horse and rider in the water. To the lower right, a group of birds are gathered at the water's edge.

artworks.title: The Gathering of Manna
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Faya Causey in memory of Philip Conisbee
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a group of individuals in a landscape featuring rocks and trees. The people are engaged in different activities and interactions. In the background, there are tent-like structures near mountains. The sky has textured clouds, adding drama to the scene. The ground shows people in different postures and expressions, creating a sense of movement and storytelling.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Young Girl, Plate 14
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper mounted on light brown laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Faya Causey in memory of Philip Conisbee
artworks.description: The image features a portrait of a young person's upper torso. The subject is seated facing forward with their head slightly turned towards their right. They have large, alert eyes and a youthful appearance, with mid-length bobbed hair and a fringe across the forehead. The clothing is elaborate, with a high collar, patterned fabric, puffed sleeves, and decorative detailing on the fitted bodice. There is no visible jewelry or objects held by the person. The background is a simple gradient shading, and the portrait is mounted on a plain piece of paper. The number "14" is visible in the top right corner of the portrait.

artworks.title: Paul Preaching at Athens
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Faya Causey in memory of Philip Conisbee
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of individuals gathered around a figure speaking on a raised platform. The scene depicts the figure, in a flowing robe, gesturing upwards as they address the assembled crowd, some of whom are seated while others stand. The gathering takes place against the backdrop of classical architecture, featuring columns and a domed structure. Details such as a guard with a spear standing near the crowd, and the various expressions and attentiveness of the listeners, add to the narrative depth of the scene. The artwork is framed with a decorative border.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.artist: comte de Anne-Claude-Philippe de Tubières Caylus, after Guercino
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Faya Causey in memory of Philip Conisbee
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is visible in the upper third of the image, with sketchy trees and bushes. Trees with gnarled trunks and sparse foliage are prominent, some tilted dramatically. Two small figures are seen in the distance. The image features detailed lines of varying thickness to show texture and depth, and a monochrome color palette of black lines on an off-white background.

artworks.title: La Montagne qui accouche (The Mountain Giving Birth)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Faya Causey in memory of Philip Conisbee
artworks.description: The image shows four people outdoors in a rocky landscape. One person on the left has hair tied up and wears a flowing garment with puffed sleeves. Two other women in flowing robes are nearby, with one holding a child while seated on the ground. The child faces the three women. In the background are tall mountains under a cloudy sky, and a tree with twisting branches is near the group.

artworks.title: Démolitions pour le percement du Boulevard Saint-Germain (Demolitions for the Construction of the Boulevard St. Germain, Paris)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Faya Causey in memory of Philip Conisbee
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene of urban destruction and reconstruction. In the foreground, there is rubble and fragmented building materials in an urban demolition site. The city skyline is filled with fragmented building facades. In the background, intact structures and cranes can be seen framing the image. The etching technique uses fine lines and cross-hatch shading to create texture and define shapes and shadows. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray and black. A domed building is visible in the distant background. The sky has scattered clouds.

artworks.title: Baudelaire
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Faya Causey in memory of Philip Conisbee
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a man's head and shoulders. His gaze is directed towards the viewer. The man has a mustache, goatee, and short dark hair styled away from his face. He wears a collared garment with a bow tie or cravat. The background is plain, and the etching is mounted on textured paper. The artist's signature is in the bottom right corner of the image.

artworks.title: Le Luxembourg
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper mounted on black wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Faya Causey in memory of Philip Conisbee
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of a park or garden setting. In the foreground, there is a paved area with a woman, a baby carriage, another person attending to a child, and a child playing with a hoop and stick. Beyond them is a fenced area leading to a lush garden with trees and shrubbery. In the background, a grand building's dome rises above the treetops, setting the horizon. The etching style features intricate details in the foliage and architecture, all in shades of black on a cream background.

artworks.title: La Butte-aux-Cailles
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint with roulette on Japanese paper mounted on black wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Faya Causey in memory of Philip Conisbee
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with an urban area in the distance. The horizon is above the center line of the image, where buildings make up the urban skyline. Smokestacks emit dark smoke into the sky. Nearby, there are simple wooden structures and leafless trees. The urban area has densely packed buildings with various rooftops. The artwork features fine lines and cross-hatch shading. The color palette is primarily grayscale. Farther away, livestock graze in an open field.

artworks.title: Das Weihnachtsfest
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Christopher and Beverly With in memory of Karl and Gerda With
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of individuals observing a display. One adult figure stands in the center, facing the large display, with their back to the viewer. Surrounding them are other figures, including a woman on the left holding a young child up to the display, and another child reaching out. On the right, there is another adult sitting on a rocking horse with additional children. The display features a large figure in a gown with a chandelier-like structure above, lit with candles. Smaller figures resembling toy soldiers and children surround the central figure. The background is dark, and the candles create a glowing effect.

artworks.title: On the Wharf
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Christopher and Beverly With in memory of Karl and Gerda With

artworks.title: George Sand
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Manfred Heiting, Los Angeles

artworks.title: Portrait of a Couple in the Guise of Angelica and Medoro
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from The Ahmanson Foundation and the Edward E. MacCrone Fund
artworks.description: The image is a circular portrait showing two upper bodies slightly embracing. The person on the left has curly brown hair, a long nose, and full lips. He wears an orange sash and a red cloak. The person on the right has brown wavy hair. She wears a white draped cloth and a delicate bracelet. The background shows foliage. The artwork is in a metallic frame with a loop.

artworks.title: Climbing into America
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Leslie and Judith Schreyer and Gabrielle Schreyer-Hoffman

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated from the waist up. She is sitting upright with one arm on an upholstered chair with a floral design. Her hair is styled in waves, framing her face. She has a calm expression and is wearing a dark dress with lace details, a white collar and cuffs, and a cameo. The background is plain, and the image is framed in gold with intricate detailing.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image displays a woman in a portrait from the waist up. She is seated and turned slightly to her left, looking towards her right. She has a calm expression, dark hair styled in an updo with adornments on both sides, wearing a dark formal dress with lace details and a high collar. She holds an item in her right hand. The background is dark, and the portrait is in an ornate frame with a gold inner border.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body, from just below the waist upwards. He is slightly turned to his right, sitting with his left arm resting on a surface. The man has short, wavy dark hair and a prominent facial structure with high cheekbones and a slight smile. He wears a dark, double-breasted coat with large buttons over a dark collar and a visible white shirt underneath. The background is plain and neutral. The photograph is bordered by an ornate frame with gold accents.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man and Woman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated man and woman from the waist up. The man is on the left, sitting upright with one arm around the woman and the other holding an object or piece of paper. He has dark, combed-back hair, a broad face with a small smile, and wears a dark suit with a buttoned jacket and waistcoat, as well as a white dress shirt with a high collar. The woman, seated on the right, leans slightly toward the man, has a serious expression, and wears a white bonnet over darker hair, a dark shawl over her shoulders, and a lighter garment underneath. She holds a fan or similar object. The background is plain and dark, emphasizing the couple in a framed portrait typical of the period, enclosed in a rectangular frame with an oval cut-out. A gold mat surrounds the photograph within a maroon border.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a head-and-shoulders portrait of a man facing slightly to the right, with his gaze directed towards the camera. His facial features include a well-groomed mustache and beard combination that frames his lips. His hair is combed back from a high forehead, with visible hair receding at the temples but styled to show soft waves. He is dressed formally in a dark coat with a white shirt underneath, along with a cravat or bow tie wrapped around his neck. The photograph is housed in an ornate frame with a gold border and has a plain dark background. The daguerreotype is enclosed in a case with a red velvet lining around the inner perimeter under the glass cover.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated in a three-quarter view. He has short, slicked-back white hair with sideburns, and is wearing wire-rimmed glasses. The man is dressed in formal attire - a black jacket with wide lapels, a white shirt with a high collar, a dark waistcoat and bow tie. The background is plain and dark. The portrait is held in an oval frame with gold border and glass cover.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man from the torso up. He is in a three-quarter stance, with crossed arms and a composed expression. His facial features are defined, with a serious look, angular jaw, high cheekbones, straight nose, and dark, combed-back hair. He wears a dark suit with a white shirt and cravat. The background is plain, and the portrait is in a yellowed, aged frame with dark spots and a red border, hinting at an older photograph like a daguerreotype.
